More and more people like shopping online. It is fast and easy: you can order almost everything with your phone, and the products arrive at your door in one or two days. Online shops are also open twenty-four hours a day.

However, some people still prefer shopping in real stores. When you buy clothes or shoes, you can try them on and make sure they fit. If something is wrong with a product, you can take it back to the store and change it at once.

I usually buy books and paper online because they are cheaper, but I never buy shoes on the Internet. Last month my cousin ordered a pair of shoes online. When they arrived, they were the wrong size, and he had to wait a week for the right ones.
